prompt: Single game hero sprite: A top-heavy lion beastman brawler about 3 heads tall (a huge spiky dark red-brown mane around the head and over the shoulders, a broad bare chest and huge forearms, a narrow waist, short strong legs), golden-tan fur with a cream muzzle and a cream chest patch, a short snout with a dark nose, a fierce brow line and two small eye slits, two small round ears in the mane; he wears only a saturated blue waist sash with one short hanging cloth end and blue trousers to the knee, big bare paw feet; on EACH fist a big bright-gold gauntlet with three short curved claws; a long thin tail with a dark tuft curving up behind him; no other weapon; golden-tan main colour, saturated blue cloth, bright gold claws. SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera: facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the screen, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer so the face and the front of the chest are visible, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body. Not a flat profile, not a front view, not a diagonal three-quarter view toward the bottom-right. Standing UPRIGHT in a calm, proud idle stance: the body vertical, not leaning and not walking diagonally, both feet planted apart on ONE horizontal ground line, both arms hanging down at his sides, held a little AWAY from the body so there is a clear gap between each arm and the torso, the clawed fists low at hip height, claws pointing down, not raised to strike; the tail behind him on the left, clear of the legs. Full body, centered, filling about 70% of the frame. The face is only a brow line and a small eye slit; hands are simple fists inside the gauntlets, visible. No buckles, no pouches, no straps beyond one, no rope, no bandages, no spikes, no stitches, no patches, no fabric texture, no fur texture: fur and clothing are a few big flat shapes. At most three colour families. The claws, the mane, the tail and every part of the body stay inside the frame with margin on every side. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no border. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject. Stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a top-down fantasy tower defense game, designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Simple design: big clear shapes and a strong silhouette; small details are left out or merged into larger shapes; faces, hands, armour and clothing are suggested with a few lines, never rendered in fine detail. Stylized, exaggerated cartoon proportions, not realistic anatomy (about 2.5 to 4 heads tall): the parts that express the character's role are enlarged and the rest is shrunk, so the silhouette reads at 60 pixels. Colour: flat solid fills only, no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Volume and shadow come from 2-3 hard-edged tones of the same colour (shadow, base, light), plus a few small highlight shapes. Thick clean outlines in a dark shade of the neighbouring colour. Effects (fire, ice, magic, poison, glow, energy) are drawn as stacked layers of flat single-colour vector shapes with an outline that follows the effect's form (flame tongues, ice shards, drips, sparks), never as soft blur or gradient glow. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
